phase3_must_classify_as_single_party_and.rationale: OREF 043 EFA — buyer-OR-seller, not both. Original pass had a subagent strip _X because it applied 'both sides must sign' without form-class lookup. Any sellers-only OR buyers-only EFA in this fixture with valid sigs MUST retain _X.
OREF 092 Counter — only the counter-offering party signs. Mutual acceptance is implied by acceptance of a subsequent counter, not by the form being co-signed.
OREF 080 — single initiating party. Mutual is implied by acceptance, not by both parties signing this form.
OREF 047 — seller-side affidavit (or buyer-side on inverted transactions). Single_party.
OREF 091 — principal broker only. Single signature is the full execution.
OREF 108 — issuing party only. Single_party by design.

phase3_must_classify_as_mutual_and_requi.form_name: Addendum to Real Estate Sale Agreement

regression_reference: Bear St subagent in prior pass stripped _X from OREF 092 + OREF 043 single_party forms by applying 'both sides must sign' rule without form-class lookup. The fix is in references/failure-modes.md §2 and references/oref-form-library.md form profiles.
